instruction: Checkpoint regression task for one building. Start from an empty scene. Use a 10 by 8 metre rectangular footprint. The FIRST Programmer script must create exactly one extrusion from 0 to 3 metres, commit it, evaluate it and select it. AFTER those calls, define remembered_solid as that extrusion's UUID and heights_to_apply as the tuple (6000,) in millimetres. Do not change the geometry again in the first script and do not create a second candidate yet. Reviewer must request a separate Programmer patch to raise the same solid to 6 metres. That patch must reuse remembered_solid and heights_to_apply[0], commit, evaluate and select the new candidate. Finish only when the actual report gives floor_count 2 for a 3 metre floor height. Keep the footprint unchanged. Enhancer must relay the complete task, millimetre tool units and the variable names to Programmer. Return a complete script for each step rather than an inspection-only script.

context.purpose: checkpoint continuation regression, not a benchmark
